hypothesis: Monotonic fence tokens prevent an expired worker from committing after ownership transfer.
hypothesis_outcome_boundary: Supported for the executed SQLite shared-store mechanism and sanitized local concurrency model. Networked consensus, hostile database writers, cross-host clocks, and crash/reboot liveness are not generalized.

method.summary: Implemented a transactional lease/fence store, froze exact adversarial falsifiers, forced a two-thread stale-worker interleaving, ran focused and seeded tests, and repeated the ownership-transfer fixture 64 times.
method.atomicity: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes token allocation and commit validation against one durable current-lease row.
method.commit_predicate: candidate.fence_token == current.fence_token AND candidate.owner_id == current.owner_id AND candidate.lease_id == current.lease_id AND observed_time < current.expires_at_ns
method.critical_ordering: The commit predicate is evaluated before idempotency replay handling.
method.exact_falsifier: Any fence-1 post-transfer commit accepted, any successor token other than 2, duplicate fence-2 grants under contention, or a durable payload not owned by the current fence-2 worker.

tests.first_pass_evidence: The original 22 tests passed, but post-test safety review found that commit sampled its clock before waiting for the SQLite write lock. That uncovered TOCTOU defect was repaired and a lock-wait-across-expiry adversarial test now passes.

wall_time.precision: invocation timestamp to first complete producer-worktree verification

preregistered_metrics.defect_detail: Commit time was sampled before transaction-lock acquisition, allowing a lock wait to span expiry while validation used the old time.
preregistered_metrics.provider_observation: Execution was not blocked, but requested gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh was not the provider-reported run model; observed gpt-5.6-sol-max-fast. Separate reasoning attestation was unavailable.
